title: Jazz the Cleaner
lyrics:
[Verse]
I got Jazz the cleaner comin' over at noon
She gets down, turns the place around
Said she only needs an hour or two
To get it all nice and clean

[Pre-Chorus]
She says, "Now, please don't bother me
While I play my music and do my thing"
I said, "Do your thing, do your thing"

[Chorus]
I hired her to clean my house
I don't know what happened, but it's upside down
She's puttin' on the jazz
She's puttin' on the jazz
She's puttin' on the jazz
Now the place is nice and clean
